lines.en: Here's your copy of the bill. We hope you enjoyed your stay.
Oh, we did. And you still have all your lamps.
No, I didn't factor in the room tax.
Oh, dude, don't worry about it.
I found an unattended maid's car.
We're way ahead of the game.
There's something new in the bowl.
Look, we have enough. Just walk away.
Oh, but I want the pine cones.
Thank you for a delightful stay.
